title: Team directory — Ledger team
text: The Ledger team owns ledger-service and the settlement database schema. Team lead: Nino Kapanadze. On-call rotation is weekly, handover on Mondays at 10:00.

title: Team directory — SRE
text: The SRE team owns api-gateway, Kafka and the deployment tooling (deployctl). Team lead: Levan Beridze. SRE is the escalation point for all production incidents.

title: Team directory — Notifications team
text: The Notifications team owns notification-service, receipt e-mails and merchant webhooks. Team lead: Mariam Gelashvili.
